title: proactive-shadow-canary-autorollback-enhancements
author: Diego Ramirez
description: Motivation: improve rollout safety for shadow+canary patterns by adding a proactive probing stage that exercises model variants before traffic weighting and by tightening metric quorum and observability hooks so automated rollback decisions are more robust. Summary: this PR implements a new proactive_probing state in the unified rollout state machine, exposes configuration knobs for probing sample size and quorum thresholds, adds explicit metric tagging for rollback telemetry, wires additional tracing spans and alertable events to the console, and includes e2e and unit tests plus migration notes. The proactive probing stage sends a configurable number of shadow requests to the candidate variant and evaluates a composite metric quorum (latency p95, error ratio, semantic-quality fallback rate). If quorum fails the rollout transitions to quarantine and triggers a rollback; if quorum passes we proceed to canary/A-B traffic weighting as before. Backward compatibility: default rollout configs remain unchanged unless proactive_probing is enabled (opt-in). Checklist: 1) implement state machine changes and guards; 2) add metric quorum evaluator and config validation; 3) plumb tracing/console events and increase telemetry cardinality for rollout_id/model_version; 4) add unit tests for quorum math and state transitions; 5) add e2e tests that run a short probing flow with a deterministic test harness; 6) docs and migration notes; 7) feature-flag gated rollout for 2 weeks before full enable. Testing: unit tests added and passing; e2e tests added to the rollout-test job and initially flaky on first run due to test harness timeout tuning, fixed and rerun. Observability: emitted events: rollout.probing.started, rollout.probing.completed, rollout.probing.quarantine_triggered, rollout.probing.quorum_eval with tags {metric_namespace, rollout_id, model_version, region}. Rollout config schema changes: optional "proactive_probing" block with fields {enabled:boolean, sample_size:int, quorum: [{metric:string, comparator:string, threshold:float, weight:float}], timeout_ms:int}. Migration: service-side will ignore unknown config keys, recommended client SDKs updated to validate schema; Console will hide the probing section unless feature-flag enabled. Rollout plan: feature flagged behind rollout.probing.enabled by default false; enable in staging, observe telemetry and canary results for 48h, then enable for a handful of internal tenants before wider opt-in. Implementation notes: - reuse existing shadowing plumbing and KV cache behavior to avoid duplicating payloads - reuse existing metrics pipeline and add a lightweight aggregator for the quorum evaluation to avoid hot path overhead - sampling is done upstream of scoring so we only evaluate the configured sample set - added guard to prevent overlapping probing windows for same rollout id.

review_comments: Aisha Malik: Nice design. Two asks before approving: (1) make metric names configurable at the service-level (not hardcoded); (2) ensure we emit rollout_id in all traces. Can you add a basic unit test for trace propagation?

Ravi Patel: Please add a small safety guard to avoid simultaneous probing runs for the same rollout across replicas — a distributed lock or lease would work. Also the quorum weights need a comment describing normalization.
Diego Ramirez: implemented a lease-based probe coordinator using existing lease manager and added documentation comment for weight normalization. Marked for re-review.
Laura Chen: e2e failures looked flaky on first run, rerun confirmed green. I reviewed the state machine logic and unit tests; small nits inline but overall LGTM.
Aisha Malik: approved after one small lint fix in probing_handler.py (applied).
release_notes: Enhancement: add optional proactive probing stage to unified rollouts for shadow+canary deployments. Adds composite metric quorum evaluation, new telemetry events, and console UI for probing. Opt-in via config; no breaking changes by default.
notes: Follow-up items: 1) add telemetry dashboard in observability-pack (ENG-1907); 2) schedule canary for a set of internal tenants and monitor rollout.probing.quorum_eval for 72h; 3) evaluate cost impact of additional shadowing in Dedicated accounts and consider a rate limiter.
